from manim import *
import numpy as np

class Section3Scene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        """
        Sets up the background, title, and bullet points on the left side.
        """
        # Set background
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        
        # Title at the top
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=32, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Bullet points container (Left side)
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"• {line}", font_size=24, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.4)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.7)
        
        # Grid initialization for right-side visuals
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]
        
        # Define 6x6 grid coordinates restricted to the right half of the screen
        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # x shifts to the right side (0.5 to 5.5), y spans center (-2.5 to 2.5)
                x = 1.0 + j * 0.8
                y = 2.0 - i * 0.8
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        """
        Utility to place a mobject at a specific grid coordinate.
        """
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        # Configuration for Section 3: Holomorphic Dynamics
        title_content = "Holomorphic Dynamics & Iteration"
        lecture_bullets = [
            "Complex Plane Mapping",
            "Fixed Points & Stability",
            "The Iteration z_{n+1} = f(z_n)",
            "Defining the Julia Set"
        ]

        # 1. Initialize Layout
        self.setup_layout(title_content, lecture_bullets)
        
        # Animate bullets one by one
        for bullet in self.lecture:
            self.play(FadeIn(bullet, shift=RIGHT), run_time=0.6)

        # 2. Visual Representation: Complex Mapping
        # Creating a small coordinate system on the right grid
        plane_center = self.grid["C3"]
        plane = ComplexPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=3,
            y_length=3,
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.4}
        ).move_to(plane_center)

        # Function label
        func_label = MathTex("f(z) = z^2 + c", font_size=30, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(func_label, "A3")

        self.play(
            Create(plane),
            Write(func_label),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        # 3. Iteration Visualization
        # Example points: mapping z_0 -> z_1 -> z_2
        z0_val = 0.5 + 0.2j
        c_val = -0.4 + 0.3j
        
        z0_point = plane.n2p(z0_val)
        dot0 = Dot(z0_point, color=BLUE, radius=0.08)
        lbl0 = MathTex("z_0", font_size=20).next_to(dot0, UR, buff=0.05)

        self.play(FadeIn(dot0), Write(lbl0))

        # Iteration 1
        z1_val = z0_val**2 + c_val
        z1_point = plane.n2p(z1_val)
        dot1 = Dot(z1_point, color=RED, radius=0.08)
        arrow1 = Arrow(dot0.get_center(), dot1.get_center(), buff=0.1, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow1), FadeIn(dot1))

        # 4. Symbolic Logic on the Grid
        chaos_text = Text("Chaotic Motion", font_size=22, color=RED)
        self.place_at_grid(chaos_text, "F3")
        
        rect = SurroundingRectangle(chaos_text, color=RED, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(
            Write(chaos_text),
            Create(rect)
        )

        # Final Wait
        self.wait(3)
